item.text: The behavioral refactor is validated. I’m clearing the generated bytecode from the source root and then I’ll summarize the structural improvement.

I continued the refactor in [RedBlackTree.java](/Users/allenjiang/Documents/ACE-Sycophancy-Codebase-Dataset/_worktrees/045_red_black_tree_insertion/RedBlackTree.java:42) by removing the last shared mutable insertion coordinator. The recursive insert path now returns an explicit `InsertionResult` containing the updated subtree root plus any rotation requested from its parent, instead of mutating a separate state object as control unwinds.

That makes the insertion flow in [RedBlackTree.java](/Users/allenjiang/Documents/ACE-Sycophancy-Codebase-Dataset/_worktrees/045_red_black_tree_insertion/RedBlackTree.java:95) easier to follow: recurse, attach child, detect the red-red conflict at the current frame, apply any child-requested rotation, then return either a recolored subtree or a new pending rotation for the caller. The behavior is unchanged, but the control flow is more explicit and local.
